learner_operation: Integrate n/(ax+b) by linear substitution and select the antiderivative n/a ln|ax+b|+C from five mathematical radio choices.

fixed_features.feature: One constant numerator over a nonconstant affine denominator
fixed_features.justification: Canonical e-449 and Introduction tutorial use one affine substitution.

fixed_features.feature: Five radio choices containing logarithmic antiderivatives with +C
fixed_features.justification: All six captured practice banks use this response structure; no free-entry requirement.

fixed_features.feature: Small integer coefficients and one substitution
fixed_features.justification: Preserves the easy workload of the complete source questions. Particular signs, nonunit slope direction, correct coefficient rank and choice position are not essential.

answer_roles.role: Numerator and affine slope jointly determine logarithm coefficient
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Change n and signed nonzero a independently within the small-number source method; correct coefficient can be positive fractional, negative or integral.
answer_roles.observed: Every a>0 is fixed to 1; all a<0 cases fix n=1. Canonical [3,5,2] is rejected by all profiles. No positive fractional correct coefficient occurs.

answer_roles.role: Correct coefficient rank and form among distractors
answer_roles.eligible_variation: The coefficient n/a should determine correctness, with other bank members occasionally larger/smaller or sharing sign/fraction form.
answer_roles.observed: Coefficient templates always make maximum positive coefficient correct. Negative-slope template always makes the unique negative proper fraction correct.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Affine intercept and signs may change; visual choice position may change without changing correctness.
answer_roles.observed: Intercepts and arguments vary; UI hashes IDs to shuffle display. Unit-slope identity simplifications are legitimate.

coverage.result: All five profiles reject [3,5,2]; q-49511 template [2,3,5] is absent. Complete canonical solution and Introduction support the omitted operation.

counterfactuals.change: Hold template q-15707, seed 912, slope 1 and intercept 7; change numerator 2 to 3.
counterfactuals.expected: Response and solution coefficient must change 2 to 3.
counterfactuals.observed: Prompt, substitution algebra, final answer and native accepted choice all follow numerator. Actual UI screenshots checked. Bank-only maximum-positive action nevertheless remains valid.
counterfactuals.justification: Numerator is relevant through n/a. This passing dependency check does not waive the shortcut defect.

counterfactuals.change: Hold [2,1,7] and seed 912; change equals-ending wording q-15707 to Calculate wording q-49453.
counterfactuals.expected: Same mathematical response despite different question/choice identifiers.
counterfactuals.observed: Both render integral 2/(x+7); answer and solution remain 2 ln|x+7|+C. Native grader accepts this member and rejects four distractors in each.
counterfactuals.justification: The two source wording templates have identical mathematical operation and equivalent five-choice banks.

weighted easy-band selection and history exclusion
delivery.result: Fresh resampling trace: 19 attempts -> 15 unique records, four duplicates skipped. Delivery: independent 70 -> 50; exact batch 5 -> 5. Both structural bank cues survive. All generated records are easy, keyed radio questions; positive-weight easy selection can serve them and cannot change their bank relationships. No prepared publication file exists; shared read-only delivery adapter used. Inventory basis 5669 contains only original sources, no eligible historical generated records.

limitations: Finite fresh sample and boundaries support the stated probes, not absence of every possible shortcut.
Actual learner policies, histories and future entity IDs are not captured; selection analysis uses the real hash/weight rules with surrogate IDs and states the resulting limits.
q-49511 lacks source solution, correct link and difficulty; inferred key is mathematically clear but not represented as captured source evidence.
Moderate and hard are outside the requested easy level.
The required changes are generator construction changes; original source records must remain unchanged.
